fixtures.preview: Pochettino's second game in charge comes three days after a 4-0 defeat at Anfield; kick-off is 7am Thursday 26 Nov in Sydney.
talking_points: United sit 19th on 8 points from 11 games, their fewest at this stage since 1972-73, per Opta's The Analyst.
Leny Yoro was sent off after 8 minutes at Anfield, the earliest red card for a United player in the Premier League; Pochettino called it 'completely unfair', and any suspension is unconfirmed.
United have conceded 34 goals in all competitions, the most in Europe's top five leagues, and face a Sporting side listed 10th in the league phase.
No team news is confirmed yet, so line-ups and injuries are still to come.

fixtures.preview: Pochettino's first game at Old Trafford, 3pm UK time Saturday 28 Nov (2am Sunday in Sydney), with United 19th after the Anfield loss.
A Wednesday-night trip to Tyneside at 8pm UK time; Sky notes fixtures are subject to change.
A Saturday 3pm home game that could matter at the bottom of the table; Coventry's current position wasn't re-checked.
The first Big Blue of the season, after a Matchweek 6 bye for Sydney.
talking_points: Sydney drew 0-0 away to Brisbane Roar on Saturday and sit third on the ladder after five rounds, with four points from their last two games.
Coach Patrick Kisnorbo said his side were 'a bit sloppy' before half-time but responded well after the break.
Jacob Farrell made his debut after a long injury layoff, and injuries and thin depth have forced several young players into debuts.
Oriola Sunday and Al Hassan Touré were the main threats against Brisbane but couldn't convert late chances.

fixtures.preview: A Grand Final rematch in Auckland at 5pm NZ time (3pm Sydney), Matchweek 8.
Sunday 5pm at WIN Stadium in Wollongong, listed on Sydney FC's ticket page as a game away from Allianz Stadium.

notes: Search and fetch tools were limited again this run: BBC, the Guardian, manutd.com and Sky were blocked, and supermarket and Rebel pages couldn't be read. Arts, son, daughter and family_fun mostly carry over earlier items checked against Time Out's and Ella's List weekend guides.

Man Utd lost 4-0 at Liverpool on 22 Nov (ESPN, NBC and The Analyst agree) and are 19th on 8 points. Any Yoro suspension is unconfirmed and Sporting team news isn't out yet. Stan Sport as broadcaster was carried over from an earlier check; the Paramount+ page I opened only covers US streaming.

Sydney FC: the ticket page lists a Sun 20 Dec game vs Central Coast Mariners at WIN Stadium, Wollongong, and the 6 Dec Big Blue without naming the opponent (Melbourne Victory is carried over). Paramount+ as broadcaster was carried over from an earlier check.
Big matches: broadcasters weren't re-checked. Sydney times are my reading of the UK kick-offs.

Live sport: no Sydney tennis, rugby union or Matildas/Socceroos home games were found. A Kings v Perth game on 6 Dec appeared on listing sites, but the NBL page I opened listed only the Christmas Day game (Fri 25 Dec, time TBC), so I left both out.
Local: school dates come from the Term 4 calendar and the Week 6 Principal Update and may change. Nothing was found for the second school.
Groceries: this week's specials end tonight (Tue 24 Nov), so only the healthier items are kept; I couldn't find the new Wed 25 Nov specials or any Aldi prices.

Deals: Rebel's Black Friday page was blocked, so no football-boot discounts are listed; Black Friday is Fri 27 Nov and more should appear. Many links go to OzBargain posts, so check the retailer before buying.

Son and daughter sections are thin: no junior parkrun, Roblox or kids' author event was confirmed. A Pokémon card swap in Blacktown (12 Dec) and a 5K Foam Fest (5 Dec) turned up in search but weren't opened. Sydney FC's holiday clinic dates aren't published.
Arts: Whispering Jack prices weren't confirmed from an opened page; check the STC site.
